name: Spindle
lore: A carved spinning top whose restless dance keeps forgotten winds alive.

primary.name: Spiral Dart
primary.description: Fire a curving spiral dart for 20 damage. Alternate its curve with each shot.

secondary.name: Orbit Dance
secondary.description: Three shards circle you for 2.4 seconds. Each shard can hit each enemy once for 10 damage.

special.name: Heart of the Whirl
special.description: Create a vortex ahead of you for 3 seconds. It pulls and slows enemies, dealing 8 damage every half-second.

passive: Balanced Spin: Orbit Dance lasts one extra second.

technique.name: Long Orbit
technique.description: Orbit Dance reaches 40% farther, dealing 25% less damage per shard.

final_technique.name: Unspooled Constellation
final_technique.description: Three delayed thread stars replace the pulling vortex. 24 damage per star, but no crowd pull or sustained field.

attack.name: Unspooled Constellation
attack.description: Three delayed thread stars replace the pulling vortex. 24 damage per star, but no crowd pull or sustained field.
